description: Isolated diagnostics codebase for TruckCEO: ONE featherweight callable (diagPing) sharing NOTHING with the main functions codebase — no settlements, no providers, no Secret Manager, no env-derived module-scope config. Exists to bisect the main codebase's bare functions/internal failure: if diagPing answers while every main-codebase callable fails bare, the fault is in the main codebase's shared module graph (functions/src/index.ts module scope), not in callable plumbing, auth, or the platform.
name: truck-ceo-diag
